propositions: Core outbound link differ currently imports vendor-specific link mapping from adapters.jira, violating backend neutrality and ADR 0035 requirement that core compare only canonical shapes
Link translation logic (vendor type to canonical relation) must move from core outbound_links.py into SupportsLinks adapter capability methods map_remote_links and link_payload_for_relation
Direction-agnostic link dedup must be preserved: local dep to remote key matches regardless of which side the remote link is on (inward or outward)
ADD/REMOVE payload structure and semantics remain unchanged; opaque vendor type is carried as passenger for REMOVE payloads only
outbound_differ.py must pass SupportsLinks capability to _diff_links so core comparison uses canonical relations exclusively
